summary: This article discusses the Pusa Golden Cherry Tomato-2, a new promising yellow cherry tomato variety suitable for protected cultivation.
The variety is rich in vitamin A and vitamin C, and its fruits contain 13.02 mg/100 g fresh weight carotene, 18.3 mg/100 g fresh weight ascorbic acid, 0.33% acidity, and 9.0 brix.

The article provides information on the cultivation of Pusa Golden Cherry Tomato-2, including climate, soil, sowing time, seed rate, nursery raising, transplanting, manure and fertilizers, irrigation, interculture, training, pruning, and trellising.
It also discusses the importance of pollination, harvesting, and plant protection in the cultivation of the variety.
The article concludes by highlighting the potential of Pusa Golden Cherry Tomato-2 as a valuable crop for protected cultivation and its suitability for various regions.
